title: Fence
statementMd:
There is a fence in front of Polycarpus's home. The fence consists of $*n*$ planks of the same width which go one after another from left to right. The height of the $*i*$-th plank is $*h*_{*i*}$ meters, distinct planks can have distinct heights.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ff4898e61fdca3713f04ee1d3db5a83ac2b3ebcd.png) Fence for $*n* = 7$ and $*h* = [1, 2, 6, 1, 1, 7, 1]$

Polycarpus has bought a posh piano and is thinking about how to get it into the house. In order to carry out his plan, he needs to take exactly $*k*$ consecutive planks from the fence. Higher planks are harder to tear off the fence, so Polycarpus wants to find such $*k*$ consecutive planks that the sum of their heights is minimal possible.

Write the program that finds the indexes of $*k*$ consecutive planks with minimal total height. Pay attention, the fence is not around Polycarpus's home, it is in front of home (in other words, the fence isn't cyclic).

## Input

The first line of the input contains integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1.5·10^{5}, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$) — the number of planks in the fence and the width of the hole for the piano. The second line contains the sequence of integers $*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 100$), where $*h*_{*i*}$ is the height of the $*i*$-th plank of the fence.

## Output

Print such integer $*j*$ that the sum of the heights of planks $*j*$, $*j* + 1$, ..., $*j* + *k* - 1$ is the minimum possible. If there are multiple such $*j*$'s, print any of them.

## Note

In the sample, your task is to find three consecutive planks with the minimum sum of heights. In the given case three planks with indexes 3, 4 and 5 have the required attribute, their total height is 8.
statementZhMd:
Polycarpus 家门前有一面栅栏。栅栏由 $*n*$ 块宽度相同的木板组成，这些木板从左到右依次排列。第 $*i*$ 块木板的高度为 $*h*_{*i*}$ 米，不同木板的高度可能不同。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ff4898e61fdca3713f04ee1d3db5a83ac2b3ebcd.png) $*n* = 7$ 且 $*h* = [1, 2, 6, 1, 1, 7, 1]$ 时的栅栏

Polycarpus 买了一架豪华钢琴，正在考虑如何把它搬进屋里。为了实现这个计划，他需要从栅栏中拆下恰好 $*k*$ 块连续的木板。木板越高，就越难从栅栏上拆下来，因此 Polycarpus 希望找到总高度尽可能小的 $*k*$ 块连续木板。

请编写程序，找出总高度最小的 $*k*$ 块连续木板的起始编号。注意，栅栏并不环绕 Polycarpus 的房子，而是在房子前面（换句话说，栅栏不是循环的）。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1.5·10^{5}, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）——栅栏中木板的数量以及钢琴通道的宽度。第二行包含整数序列 $*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 100$），其中 $*h*_{*i*}$ 表示栅栏第 $*i*$ 块木板的高度。

## 输出格式

输出一个满足条件的整数 $*j*$，使得木板 $*j*$、$*j* + 1$、...、$*j* + *k* - 1$ 的高度总和最小。如果有多个这样的 $*j*$，输出其中任意一个即可。

## 说明

在样例中，你需要寻找总高度最小的三块连续木板。在给定情况下，编号为 3、4、5 的三块木板满足要求，它们的总高度为 8。
